rule: The candidate (heads fitted on the training photos under the licence rule nc, TinyCLIP 39M/16, name_at at the 92-in-100 level on val) ships unless, on the test photos, (i) its kind of eye on wildlife is worse than pocket v2's by a paired difference whose 95% interval lies wholly below zero, (ii) its kind of eye on the extra set's test photos is right for less than 96.5%, or (iii) it names a species on more than 1% of the test photos of people and rooms. The rule was set by the coordinator before the candidate was measured.
why: The candidate passes all three tests, so it ships as pocket v3.
